messages:
Rina (Eng Manager): Hey team — need clarity. We're converting Sam (US) from IC5 individual contributor into a people manager role mid-cycle (IC5 -> Mgr-2) with comp uplift and a one-time sign-on style retention bonus. What flow do I follow? Is this a promotion, conversion, or new hire process?
Priya (People Ops): Hi! Good case. It's a conversion + promotion (role change) so submit a leveling packet (manager justification + org chart) AND the comp-change form. The sign-on/retention bonus is treated as a discretionary one-time payment and needs Finance OK + payroll routing.
Rina (Eng Manager): Ok. Effective_date requested = 2026-03-25. Requested base = $205,000 (current $185k). One-time bonus $7,500 to be paid on first payday after approval. Any headcount or hiring freeze issues?
Don (Compensation): >10% increase and band-crossing to manager track = comp committee required. For manager roles we need to confirm managerial responsibilities, direct reports plan, and target band midpoint. Also include a short leadership calibration note.
Kaya (Finance): One-time retention bonuses are allowed but must be approved by cost owner. Also need GL code and note if treated as taxable bonus vs deferred equity. Off-cycle payment for the bonus ok but fees apply.
Priya (People Ops): A couple admin notes: 1) mark headcount tag = "conversion_promo" 2) include manager start date and org chart (who Sam will manage) 3) flag bonus as "one_time_retention" with payout timing 4) confirm whether equity should be adjusted immediately or at next cadence.
Rina (Eng Manager): Team plan: Sam will manage two ICs starting 2026-04-01. I want equity uplift (pro-rated RSU) now and the $7.5k bonus as taxable cash. GL = ENG-MGR-11.
Don (Compensation): Equity uplift now is fine; submit grant request with promotion packet. Note net pay withholding for RSU may differ; coordinate with EquityOps. Also, manager track mapping requires a short leadership competencies note.
Priya (People Ops): Timeline: leveling committee (1-2 business days), comp committee for >10% (1-3 business days), Finance approval for bonus (1 day), then payroll. Payroll cutoff for US is 4 business days before pay date for the regular run. If approvals miss cutoff, bonus can be off-cycle.
Rina (Eng Manager): If we ask effective_date 2026-03-25 but approvals finish after cutoff, can we still backdate base pay to that date?
Don (Compensation): Yes, retro base pay can be applied once approved; payroll will issue a retro adjustment in the next run or as an off-cycle. Retro pay is taxed in the period it's paid. Make sure to indicate 'retro_effective_date' in the form.
Kaya (Finance): For the $7.5k bonus, if paid off-cycle we need a memo and cost-center signoff; off-cycle fees apply. Also note SUI and employer tax impact on bonus in the US.
Rina (Eng Manager): Any recommendation on manager announcement timing?
Priya (People Ops): Don't announce numbers until comp + Finance + leveling approvals are final. You can tell Sam "moving to manager track pending approvals; expected timeline ~3-7 business days." If retention risk is high, put 'expedite' in the packet with reason.
PeopleOpsBot: Leveling packet + comp-change form: https://redwood.company/hr/leveling_packet. Use headcount = conversion_promo, set `needs_comp_committee=true` for >10%, set `one_time_bonus=true` for bonuses.
Rina (Eng Manager): Submitted packet, attached org chart, leadership note, and marked expedite due to retention concern. Requested retro_effective_date = 2026-03-25.
Priya (People Ops): Received. Routing to leveling committee. Don, FYI flagged for comp committee.
Don (Compensation): Reviewing now. Quick checklist: leadership competency bullets, market benchmark, manager band midpoint doc, equity uplifts. If approved we'll route to Finance for bonus approval.
Kaya (Finance): Finance approved $7.5k bonus and cost center. Ping me if payroll needs off-cycle.
Don (Compensation): Comp committee approved the base increase to $205k and pro-rated RSU. Leveling committee approved manager mapping. Priya, please prepare the comp letter and manager offer changes.
Priya (People Ops): Preparing docs. Payroll note: requested effective_date = 2026-03-25; if approval clears before cutoff we'll include base pay retro in next run and bonus in regular run; otherwise bonus will be off-cycle.
Rina (Eng Manager): Thanks all. I'll tell Sam "approved and paperwork being processed" per guidance.
Kaya (Finance): One last admin: because this is a conversion to manager role, please update headcount record (change FTE classification) in HRIS. That affects reporting and hiring dashboards.
Priya (People Ops): Noted. Also archive packet in employee file for audit. Closing thread after letters sent. :white_check_mark:
